=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:100-102 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The helper unconditionally exits 0 even when hide or restore detects a failure, so callers cannot reject unsafe credential operations.
  WHY: Failed hides and restores are treated as successful by workflow callers; all reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:19-33 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide does not require a non-empty GITHUB_REPOSITORY to bind the checkout to a trusted repository identity.
  WHY: The helper can hide credentials without a trusted identity to validate during restore; reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:35-53 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide does not detect or reject configured remote.origin.pushurl values or pushInsteadOf rewrites.
  WHY: An authenticated or attacker-directed push destination can remain available during editor execution; reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:77-84 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore accepts any GitHub origin instead of verifying it matches the workflow repository or trusted support checkout before embedding GH_TOKEN.
  WHY: An editor-changed origin can receive the workflow token; reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:85-93 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore accepts extraheader scopes for untrusted repositories or all of GitHub rather than binding them to a verified origin.
  WHY: Git can apply the restored authorization header to requests for unrelated repositories; reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:62-97 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore injects credentials into earlier checkouts before validating every checkout in the marker file.
  WHY: A later checkout validation failure can leave GH_TOKEN in an earlier checkout; reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:56 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore exits silently when the marker file is missing instead of emitting the expected reason=marker_missing diagnostic.
  WHY: The missing-marker behavior lacks the expected diagnostic; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and openai_gpt-6-luna marked this BLOCKER, while google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, and z-ai_glm-5_2 marked it MAJOR.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:29-33 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `git rev-parse --git-dir` can discover a parent repository when hide is given a nested non-checkout directory, causing the parent config to be modified.
  WHY: A nested non-checkout can cause the helper to rewrite its parent repository’s origin; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro marked this BLOCKER, while google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, and z-ai_glm-5_2 marked it MAJOR.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:81 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Restore validates only the first configured remote.origin.url and does not reject additional unvalidated origin URLs.
  WHY: An attacker-controlled secondary URL can remain configured alongside the restored credential; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro marked this BLOCKER, while google_gemini-3_8-flash and minimax_minimax-m3 marked it MAJOR.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:20-24 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide exits successfully when an unrestored marker already exists instead of failing.
  WHY: A stale marker can prevent credentials from being hidden on a subsequent editor launch; both reviewers marked this MAJOR.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:53-55 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore exits successfully when GH_TOKEN is missing.
  WHY: Callers can treat a failed credential restoration as success; both reviewers marked this MAJOR.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:78-84 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Restore does not verify that an editor-changed push URL agrees with the validated origin.
  WHY: A push URL changed during editor execution can redirect authenticated pushes; these reviewers identified this behavior as a security failure.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The credential helper rejects failed hides/restores and restores auth only when the origin still names the workflow's original repository (or its trusted support checkout) and its push URL agrees"; the PR description also requires generic GitHub extraheaders to be restored scoped to the verified origin.
  expected_change_site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh hide and restore actions
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh does not reject failed hides/restores, validate GITHUB_REPOSITORY, reject pushurl or pushInsteadOf rewrites, verify origin against the trusted repository, scope extraheaders to the verified origin, or pre-validate every checkout before injecting a token; tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py reports 14 failures in CI run 37288064340.
- requirement: "Restore exits silently when the marker file is missing instead of emitting the expected reason=marker_missing diagnostic" (explicit behavior contract from the test suite)
  expected_change_site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh, restore branch near line 56
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: Line 56 does `[ -s "${marker}" ] || exit 0` with no diagnostic; test_git_credentials_hidden_and_restored_without_marker_secrets expects stderr containing `reason=marker_missing`.
- requirement: PR description states "Heal and related suites: 412 passed" and "Every other test touching the changed workflows ran on this branch and on a clean main side by side, with identical results."
  expected_change_site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: 14 tests in tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py fail at head 483258bb; CI run 37288064340 reports `14 failed, 217 passed` in tests-heal-plan-and-validation.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: lines 19-33 (hide path does not check GITHUB_REPOSITORY) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Hide does not verify GITHUB_REPOSITORY is set before hiding and restoring credentials.
  WHY: The test test_hide_fails_without_trusted_repository_identity expects failure when GITHUB_REPOSITORY is absent, but hide exits 0.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: lines 35-53 (hide strips only remote.origin.url, not remote.origin.pushurl) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Hide does not reject remote.origin.pushurl or pushInsteadOf configurations.
  WHY: Tests expect failure when a push URL or pushInsteadOf is configured, but hide exits 0.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: lines 77-84 (restore accepts any https://github.com/ origin) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore accepts any GitHub origin rather than requiring the workflow’s original repository.
  WHY: An editor-changed origin can receive GH_TOKEN during restore.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: lines 85-93 (extraheader regex accepts any GitHub path) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Extraheader restoration accepts scopes that are not constrained to the verified repository.
  WHY: An editor-added extraheader for an untrusted repository receives the token.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: lines 62-97 (restore validates and injects token per-checkout serially) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore mutates earlier checkouts before validating all checkouts in the marker file.
  WHY: An earlier checkout can receive GH_TOKEN before a later checkout validation fails.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: line 56 (restore exits 0 silently when marker file is missing) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore exits silently when the marker file is missing instead of emitting reason=marker_missing.
  WHY: The test expects the diagnostic, but restore exits 0 with empty stderr.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: lines 29-33 (git rev-parse --git-dir discovers parent repository) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `git rev-parse --git-dir` can discover a parent repository for a nested non-checkout directory.
  WHY: The helper then strips credentials from the parent repository’s origin.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: line 81 (git remote get-url origin returns all configured URLs) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore validates only the first of multiple remote.origin.url values.
  WHY: An additional attacker-controlled origin URL can remain unvalidated while credentials are restored.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh: lines 61-74 and 97-102 (failed=true but unconditional exit 0) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore failures set `failed=true` but the script unconditionally exits 0.
  WHY: Callers cannot detect credential restoration failures from exit status; all 14 CI tests expecting nonzero status fail.
- tests/test_plan_codex_step_extraction.py: line 224 (added GITHUB_WORKSPACE to test env dict) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: No defect; this test-infrastructure addition provides GITHUB_WORKSPACE so the helper can locate checkout directories.
  WHY: The reviewer reports that this change does not cause any failure.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "their editor processes drop GitHub/Telegram credentials and the raw-evidence directory pointer, and temporarily hide git checkout credentials" and "The credential helper rejects failed hides/restores and restores auth only when the origin still names the workflow's original repository (or its trusted support checkout) and its push URL agrees" and "Hiding/restoring git auth fails the editor step on error; restoration verifies the workflow repository identity, not merely the GitHub host."
  Expected change site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh
  Evidence of absence: The script does not reject failed hides or restores — it unconditionally exits 0 at line 102. It does not validate GITHUB_REPOSITORY in the hide path. It does not check or reject pushurl or pushInsteadOf rewrites. It accepts any https://github.com/ origin on restore instead of verifying it against the workflow's original repository.
